metadata.description: A portable, validated skills bundle for standard project development with fixtures, quality gates, and multi-agent support.

Use when a repair, polling, or fan-out loop must declare step/cost/wall-time budgets up front, detect degenerate repetition and ping-pong, and exit with {exitStatus, submission, budgetSpent, nudges}.
